# rmo_2000_3

Suppose $(x_1, x_2, \ldots)$ is a nonincreasing sequence of positive real
numbers, and for all $N$,

$$\sum_{i=1}^N \frac{x_{i^2}}{i} \le 1.$$

Show that for all $k$,

$$\sum_{i=1}^k \frac{x_i}{i} \le 3.$$

  ∀ k, (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by

import Mathlib

open Finset

theorem rmo_2000_3
  (x : ℕ → ℝ)
  (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
  (hmono : ∀ n, x n ≥ x (n + 1))
  (hsq : ∀ N, (Ico 1 (N + 1)).sum (fun i => x (i * i) / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 1) :
  ∀ k, (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
  intro k
  -- Let M be the largest integer such that M² ≤ k
  have h_exists_M : ∃ M : ℕ, M ≥ 1 ∧ M * M ≤ k ∧ (M + 1) * (M + 1) > k := by
    use Nat.sqrt k
    constructor
    · apply Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr
      apply Nat.sqrt_pos.mpr
      exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by simp_all [Nat.sqrt_eq_zero]
    constructor
    · have : (Nat.sqrt k) * (Nat.sqrt k) ≤ k := Nat.sqrt_mul_self _
      exact this
    · have : (Nat.sqrt k + 1) * (Nat.sqrt k + 1) > k := by
        have : k < (Nat.sqrt k + 1) * (Nat.sqrt k + 1) := by
          apply Nat.lt_succ_sqrt
        linarith
      exact this
  obtain ⟨M, hM_ge_one, hM_sq_le_k, hM_plus_one_sq_gt_k⟩ := h_exists_M
  
  -- Split the sum into two parts: up to M²-1 and from M² to k
  have h_sum_split : (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) = 
    (Ico 1 (M * M)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) + (Ico (M * M) (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) := by
    have h_disjoint : Disjoint (Ico 1 (M * M)) (Ico (M * M) (k + 1)) := by
      simp [Set.disjoint_left, Ico.eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
      intro i hi1 hi2
      linarith
    have h_union : (Ico 1 (M * M)) ∪ (Ico (M * M) (k + 1)) = Ico 1 (k + 1) := by
      ext i
      simp [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_Ico]
      constructor
      · intro h
        cases' h with h1 h2
        · left; exact h1
        · right; exact h2
      · intro h
        cases' h with h1 h2
        · left; exact h1
        · right; exact h2
    rw [← h_union]
    rw [Finset.sum_union h_disjoint]
    rfl
